record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Describe the metric approximation property for the Banach operator ideals N_p, I_p, and P_p for 1 < p <= infinity, where N_1 is the nuclear-operator ideal N, I_1 is the integral-operator ideal I, and P_1 is the absolutely summing-operator ideal P. The property asks for finite-rank approximants to the identity that control ||T S_alpha|| in the corresponding operator-ideal norm for every operator T in the ideal.

evidence.quote: More generally, recalling that N = N1, I = I1, P = P1, one is interested in the following.
Problem 5.2 (cf. Problem 5.4 in [4]). Describe the MAP for Np, Ip, Pp, 1 < p ≤ ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space and let $1 < p \le \infty$. Recall the following $p$-Banach operator ideals, each equipped with its natural ideal norm:

- $\mathcal{N}_p$, the ideal of $p$-nuclear operators (so that $\mathcal{N}_1 = \mathcal{N}$ is the classical nuclear-operator ideal);
- $\mathcal{I}_p$, the ideal of $p$-integral operators (so that $\mathcal{I}_1 = \mathcal{I}$ is the classical integral-operator ideal);
- $\mathcal{P}_p$, the ideal of absolutely $p$-summing operators (so that $\mathcal{P}_1 = \mathcal{P}$ is the classical absolutely summing-operator ideal).

For a Banach operator ideal $(\mathcal{A}, \|\cdot\|_{\mathcal{A}})$, say that a Banach space $X$ has the metric approximation property for $\mathcal{A}$ (MAP for $\mathcal{A}$) if there exists a net $(S_\alpha)$ of finite-rank operators on $X$ with $\|S_\alpha\| \le 1$ for all $\alpha$ such that $S_\alpha 	o \mathrm{id}_X$ uniformly on compact subsets of $X$, and such that for every Banach space $Y$ and every operator $T \in \mathcal{A}(X, Y)$ one has
$$\lim_\alpha \|T \circ S_\alpha - T\|_{\mathcal{A}} = 0 \quad 	ext{(or, equivalently, } \limsup_\alpha \|T \circ S_\alpha\|_{\mathcal{A}} \le \|T\|_{\mathcal{A}}	ext{)}.$$

Problem. For each $1 < p \le \infty$, characterize the Banach spaces $X$ that possess the MAP for $\mathcal{N}_p$, for $\mathcal{I}_p$, and for $\mathcal{P}_p$, and describe the relationships between these three approximation properties and the classical (metric) approximation property of $X$.
artifact.status_search_result: No specific published characterization of the MAP for the ideals $\mathcal{N}_p$, $\mathcal{I}_p$, $\mathcal{P}_p$ for $1<p\le\infty$ was located. The problem is posed as an open problem in the Banach space literature, and the available references on $p$-summing/$p$-nuclear/$p$-integral approximation properties (work of Oja, Reinov, Pietsch and others) treat related but not identical questions. Status appears to remain open.
